title: FAIRGAMER: Evaluating Biases in the Application of Large Language Models to Video Games

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the discount percentages offered by LLM-controlled NPC shopkeepers to customers of different real-world races (White, Black, Asian) and fictional races (e.g., Orcs, Elves).
Analyzing the discount percentages offered by LLM-controlled NPC shopkeepers to customers holding different professions or classes (e.g., management vs. service roles).
Evaluating the diplomatic decisions (Support/Neutral/Oppose) made by LLM-controlled nations against specific other nations in a strategy game simulation.
Assessing the selection frequency of culturally specific items (e.g., alcoholic beverages) from different global regions (Europe, Asia, Africa, etc.) when generating game shop inventories.
Comparing decision distributions and bias metrics (Dlstd) across prompts provided in English versus Chinese to identify inconsistencies in model behavior across languages.
